Day 6 — July 7, 2026

Today I launched the CreatorPlaybooks Virtual Mentor Lab using the 6 mentor playbooks:

1. Maya: shipped the live lab loading all mentors and asked for feedback on what to add next
2. KP: made the launch social with replies, DMs, and builder amplification
3. Jai Bhagat: taught the API-to-card workflow and the fallback system
4. Gerrit Halfmann: turned the launch into proof of work with real cover art and long-tail SEO
5. Lynn Zeng: framed the launch as a visual story with a reusable prompt
6. Zoth Studio Team: made the offer clear and pointed people straight to the live lab

Result: Day 6 is live — every mentor loads from the API, covers render from real assets, missing media falls back to animated canvases, and the lab is launch-ready.

Built with influence from the CreatorPlaybooks mentor playbooks.

Image made with @antigravity

Day 6 - July 7, 2026

I build static Netlify-ready creator labs that:
- pull live mentor data from a public API
- render real cover art on every card
- fall back gracefully to animated canvases when media is missing
- ship a daily X execution plan you can copy in one click

Who it's for: creators and builder communities shipping in public.
Outcome: one live, launch-ready lab that stays current every day.
Next step: open the lab, pick a mentor, run today's plan.

Influenced by Zoth Studio Team's CreatorPlaybooks playbook.

Image made with @antigravity

Day 6 - July 7, 2026

Visual launch story prompt:

"A cinematic wide shot of a dark neon creator lab dashboard. Thirteen glowing mentor cards float in a grid, each pulsing with its own cover art. A particle nebula drifts behind the glass panels. Text overlay: CreatorPlaybooks Virtual Mentor Lab -- live."

Repurpose the same idea into a short walkthrough clip or a 3-frame carousel. Sell the dream first, then show the real thing.

Influenced by Lynn Zeng's CreatorPlaybooks playbook.

Day 6 - July 7, 2026

What changed today:
- Live API wiring: every mentor loads from /api/creators
- Real cover images render from /creators/<id>/cover.png
- Fallback canvas keeps media alive when an asset is missing
- Launch-ready dashboard with copy-and-post prompts

Long-tail angle: live creator playbook lab powered by the CreatorPlaybooks public API on one static Netlify site. The lab home page is the productized asset.

Influenced by Gerrit Halfmann's CreatorPlaybooks playbook.
